data.one_liner: CLI tool to rename Flutter app name and bundle identifier across platforms.
data.what_it_does: Provides commands to get or set the app name and bundle ID for iOS, Android, macOS, Linux, Windows, and web projects. It edits the relevant platform files, supporting both Groovy and Kotlin Gradle scripts.
use_when: You need to change the app name or bundle identifier for an existing Flutter project across multiple platforms
You prefer a quick command‑line solution rather than manual file edits
avoid_when: Your project uses flavor configurations (may be incompatible)
You require a programmatic API to rename at runtime
You need deep integration with other build tools
strengths: Handles both Groovy and Kotlin Gradle files
weaknesses: Only a CLI tool—no Dart API for in‑app use
data.setup_notes: Run `flutter pub global activate rename` and ensure the global pub cache bin is on your PATH.
